page.layout: One page of text. Top: an ornamental rule. Below it, a centred title block, then the heading "AD STUDIOSOS." and a verse poem set in italic, full width. Bottom right: the catchword "Aliud". No margins with text.

main_text.l: Academia Marpurgensi, in Syntagma, seu Syno-
& opera à doctrina & virtute praestanti viro,

l.i: Non factum doctis, quibus experientia rerum
est, Hoc feret aetati commoda magna rudi.
Lac pueris aptum: solidus cibus aptus adultis,
Ventriculi haud omnes, omnia ferre queunt.
Quid? quod & hic aliquid, quod discat gradior
aetas, Inveniet: docta non sumus arte pares:
Dicitur ipse Solon etiam tali ore locutus:
Hoc opus ergo legens, pubes studiosa perennes,
Dona Dei lingua, famula rationis, & artes
Bilstenii hic labor est, his sine dulce nihil.

page.notes: Printed "Aliud" at bottom right is a catchword for the next page. Verse spelling follows the print; long s rendered as s. Orthographic peculiarities such as "Authori" and "Lac pueris aptum: solidus" are as printed in the scan; the scan is slightly soft in places but readable.
